scientific_integrity: The proof is a self-contained exact polynomial and covering-space computation; symbolic traces and parametrizations were recomputed with the included verifier. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic-zero cover only; no claim of a full Bernstein–Sato ideal computation.
The second branch surface is normalized but its complete singularity stratification is not classified.
The S4 group is geometric monodromy of the Galois closure, not a deck group of the degree-four cover.
title: A quartic cover with two normalized branch surfaces and full symmetric monodromy
